editorial.tldr: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 on Sep 22, with same-day availability on Amazon Bedrock, and OpenAI answered about an hour later with GPT-6 Sol and Luna. Pricing cuts of 40-50% across vendors followed, and Anthropic then shifted its pitch to cost per task rather than token price.
editorial.whats_new: Latent Space reports Opus 5.5 handles explainer-video generation well, an unusually concrete capability read that follows Anthropic's Sonnet 5.5 release on AWS on Sep 28.
editorial.why_it_matters: Per-token price is no longer the comparison that matters: Anthropic's own cost-per-task analysis shows the same token price can produce very different Claude Code bills depending on settings.
editorial.take_for_builders: Rerun your own agent workload on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 and compare cost per completed task, not cost per token, before changing your default model.

status.detail: Opus 5.5 is generally available on AWS and Anthropic's platform, with Sonnet 5.5 added the following week; independent capability reads are still accumulating.
